dialect.detail: Brazilian academic COBOL, likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar; uses DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA and Brazilian Real currency sign (R$), consistent with FATEC São Caetano coursework
evidence: CURRENCY SIGN IS "R$ " WITH PICTURE SYMBOL "$"

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian university (FATEC São Caetano) programming exercise for real estate land price calculation
purpose.summary: A student exercise program that calculates the sale price and commission for a square plot of land. It accepts hardcoded inputs (CEP, frontage, depth, price per square meter), computes total sale value and commission (4% for high-end, 6% for standard), and displays formatted results to SYSOUT.

notable_features: CURRENCY SIGN IS 'R$' with PICTURE SYMBOL '$'
LINKAGE SECTION present but PROCEDURE DIVISION has no USING clause (unused linkage)
ACCEPT FROM DATE and ACCEPT FROM TIME
Brazilian Portuguese comments and display messages
Picture clause with A(25) for alphabetic field
verdict.notes: The LINKAGE SECTION defines LK-PARAMETROS but the PROCEDURE DIVISION does not use USING, so the linkage section is vestigial or copied from a template. All data is hardcoded; no actual file I/O occurs despite FILE-CONTROL and FILE SECTION stubs. The program is clearly a student exercise from FATEC São Caetano, dated August-September 2019, authored by Alvaro Pereira do Nascimento.
